integrity: All included proof calculations use exact identities. Standalone checker exhaustively enumerates finite weak compositions but does not replace the general algebraic proof.
scientific_limitations: For tie-free samples with \(2\le n\le m\), the Rao-to-runs relationship is samplewise; exact covariance and correlation assume the common atomless two-sample null. The result does not assert new individual tests, finite critical values for their combination, or incremental test power. Historical priority under alternate terminology is possible.
title: Exact Rao–Dixon dependence and run-count collapse in circular two-sample spacing tests
